commands.name: test
commands.description: Runs each project's `test` script. Projects without one (the Next apps) are skipped rather than failing the command.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Runs ESLint across packages/ and apps/ using the `lint` autoinstaller. Enforces react-hooks/rules-of-hooks; see docs/RENDER-BOUNDARY.md.

commands.name: publish-alpha
commands.description: Runs rush publish --include-all --publish --tag alpha with XDG_CONFIG_HOME preserved so browser authentication works correctly
